image_tools_description: Make images fit the slot, the form, or the inbox.
document_ai_description: Understand and rework what a document says.
translation_description: Translate PDF and Word files between 8 languages, keep the layout, and correct the wording before you download.
summarizer_description: Get a short overview and the key points of a long document, in the length and language you choose.
extractor_description: Pull out people, organizations, dates, amounts, places and contact details, ready to copy or download.
file_tools_description: Get files into the shape someone asked for.
pdf_merge_split_description: Combine up to 20 PDFs in the order you choose, or split one PDF by page range or into single pages.
resizer_description: Resize to exact dimensions or a preset like 1200 × 630 px, and choose how the image fills the frame.
compressor_description: Make an image file smaller with a quality level you control, so uploads and email attachments go through.
converter_description: Convert PNG, JPG and WEBP images to the formats each file supports, including traced SVG paths from PNG.
jpg_to_png_description: Convert a JPG photo to a lossless PNG image.
jpg_to_webp_description: Convert a JPG photo to the smaller, web-optimized WEBP format.
png_to_webp_description: Convert a PNG image to WEBP, keeping transparency and shrinking the file.
jpg_to_svg_description: Trace a JPG photo into a scalable SVG vector image.
png_to_svg_description: Trace a PNG image into a scalable SVG vector image.
